articles.summary: A. O. Smith Corporation (NYSE: AOS), a leader in water heating and water treatment, announced today it has been recognized as a 2026 World’s Most Ethical Company by Ethisphere, a global leader in defining and advancing the standards of ethical business practices.
articles.title: Ethisphere Names A. O. Smith One of 2026 World's Most Ethical Companies | A. O. Smith Corp.
